judgment.notes: The symmetric Fourier truncations are smooth, real, mean-zero and remain in the same H^gamma ball. Since gamma>0, their L2 norms and that of u0 are at most R, so N001's stability applies with B0=2R. N005 applies to the inverse derivatives and H^1 products in S002; zero-mode removal handles intermediate products with nonzero mean. N011 applies to each truncation with exactly the same T,gamma,R,C,tau0.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
